newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 4.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* Sony's "Air Force One" simultaneously set a new August record and lifted the overall box office to a new August weekend high.
* The July box office edged to a new record for the month, $768.5 million, bettering the former high set in 1994 by 2.0 percent.
* UPN on Friday sent a letter to the WB and Sinclair claiming the station group failed to take appropriate legal action to end its affiliation with UPN, sources say.
* Universal Television signed Carrie Fisher to a two-year deal worth $3 million to develop comedies.
* Live Entertainment 40 of the company's 166 staffers on Auguest 1.

* MGM's next project -- "Disturbing Behavior" -- was written by "Con Air" writer Scott Rosenberg and will be produced by Beacon Pictures, the company behind the country's top-grossing "Air Force One."
